name: Cardano Community
description: An open platform designed to empower billions without economic identity by offering decentralized applications for managing identity, value, and governance.
longDescription: Cardano Community is built on the foundation of Cardano, an innovative and environmentally sustainable blockchain platform. At the core of Cardano is Ouroboros, the first provably secure proof-of-stake protocol based on peer-reviewed research. By combining cryptography, combinatorics, and mathematical game theory, Ouroboros ensures the protocol's integrity, longevity, and performance while minimizing energy consumption. With Ouroboros, Cardano supports the creation of distributed, permissionless networks that can sustainably support new markets. It revolutionizes the blockchain world by providing rigorous security guarantees at a fraction of the energy cost compared to traditional proof-of-work protocols. This groundbreaking technology enables Cardano to offer a secure, scalable, and energy-efficient platform for developing decentralized applications. Cardano Community is dedicated to exploring the potential of blockchain technology and contributing to the growing Cardano ecosystem. With Ouroboros as its foundation, Cardano Community aims to create a new world that is more secure, scalable, and sustainable, empowering individuals, developers, and enterprises to participate in the blockchain revolution. Join the Cardano Community and be a part of shaping the future of decentralized applications.
